verdict.rationale: Docs confirm building schedules with rotations, shadow schedules and follow-the-sun coverage, escalation paths with priority/working-hours rules, and calendar-feed import for holidays/time-off, indicating multi-team, timezone-aware coverage. However, there's no explicit documentation of 'layers' (multiple overlapping rotation layers) or 'round-robin' terminology as first-class configuration concepts, so full parity with the story's specific rotation vocabulary isn't evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit layered-schedule support, explicit round-robin assignment mechanics, and independent/hands-on validation of complex rotation setups.
